r.경제 체제: Farm goods and remittances · coffee, bananas, garment assembly
r.주요 수출품: Wire, cable 20%, Coffee 19%, Palm oil 8%, Bananas 6%, Shrimp, crab, shellfish 5% (2024, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Wire, cable 22%, Trucks 15%, Other electronics, electrical equipment 12%, Machinery, computers 10% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Coffee 42%, Ores 23%, T-shirts 11%, Sugar 10% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A presidential system with an unstable record, including a coup in 2009.

t.why: One of the 'Northern Triangle' countries at the center of US migration debates. It cut ties with Taiwan for China in 2023, and the new government that took office in 2026 is weighing restoring ties with Taiwan.
t.rel: With El Salvador and Guatemala it is called the 'Northern Triangle', at the center of US migration issues. It cut ties with Taiwan and recognized China in 2023.
t.know: One of the places where fruit companies' sway over politics gave rise to the phrase 'banana republic'.
t.etext: Coffee, bananas, shrimp and garment assembly are the main industries. Remittances from the United States make up a big part of the economy.
